name: anchor
description: Anchor Web Admin and CLI workspace gateway

scripts.admin:serve: pnpm build && node scripts/run-with-rust-toolchain.mjs cargo run --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --bin anchor -- admin serve
scripts.cli:build: pnpm build && node scripts/run-with-rust-toolchain.mjs cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --release --no-default-features --features cli --bin anchor
